title: checkpoint 截断 lineage
expected_output:
完整血缘长度 = 6
在 reduceByKey 处 checkpoint 后, 下游血缘长度 = 2
checkpoint 把血缘从 6 截断到 2, 故障重算只需从 checkpoint 文件恢复
code:
class RDD:
    _id = 0
    def __init__(self, op, parent=None, cp=False):
        RDD._id += 1
        self.rid = RDD._id
        self.op = op
        self.parent = parent
        self.checkpointed = cp
    def lineage_len(self):
        n = 1
        p = self.parent
        while p is not None:
            if p.checkpointed:
                break
            n += 1
            p = p.parent
        return n

a = RDD("parallelize")
b = RDD("map", a)
c = RDD("filter", b)
d = RDD("reduceByKey", c)
e = RDD("map", d)
f = RDD("collect", e)
d.checkpointed = False
full = f.lineage_len()
d.checkpointed = True
trunc = f.lineage_len()
print("完整血缘长度 =", full)
print("在 reduceByKey 处 checkpoint 后, 下游血缘长度 =", trunc)
print(f"checkpoint 把血缘从 {full} 截断到 {trunc}, 故障重算只需从 checkpoint 文件恢复")
